_doc: Annotation sidecar for IDWriteTextLayout. The hand subclass IDWriteTextLayout.ts adds the convenience layer (draw, getFontWeightAt, getFontAxisValuesAt, nullable fontFallback accessor) over this generated base.

IDWriteTextLayout.Draw._why: clientDrawingContext is void* (an opaque INPUT, normally 0), the heuristic mis-lowers it to an out-scalar. The hand subclass provides draw(renderer, originX?, originY?).
